facades.name: west, north wing (WN + its 2-bay end block)
facades.note: Commons 'Silodam, Stenen graansilo foto 2' (Alf van Beem 2017, public domain), wall below the cornice (heightM 0-18.4). Left half of the photo, between the white box and the tower. Rows from the quay: plinth = one segmental-arched opening per bay (2 end-block bays + 10 wing bays); then the four stacked lights of each recessed panel (the conversion's floors show as grey bands across the panel), one per bay per row; attic = one window per bay under the cornice. The tower is judged on the review sheet, not here: its door, flank columns and triple lights are a different opening order and the yacht masts cross it in this photo.

facades.name: west, south wing (WS + its 2-bay end block)
facades.note: Commons 'Silodam, Stenen graansilo foto 2' (Alf van Beem 2017, public domain), wall below the cornice (heightM 0-18.4). Right half of the photo, tower to the south end. Same rows as the north wing: 12 plinth openings, 4 rows of 12 panel lights, 12 attic windows (counted on the crop x 880-1840; the plinth is partly behind bikes but every arch shows).
